fields.label: GitLab host
fields.description: Bare hostname only — no scheme, no path, no trailing slash. Use "gitlab.com" for GitLab SaaS, or your self-managed instance's canonical hostname, e.g. "gitlab.acme.example".

fields.label: Personal access token
fields.description: A GitLab personal, project, or group access token with the api scope. Create one from GitLab under Preferences -> Access tokens.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify the personal access token (or OAuth token) by calling GET /user, which returns the authenticated user's own details. Takes no input; a 401 means the token is bad or expired.

issues.create.title: Create Issue
issues.create.description: Create an issue in a project. projectId is the numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "diaspora/diaspora") passed raw — it is percent-encoded for you automatically. The response's id is the instance-global identifier; iid is the project-scoped number every other issue endpoint takes in its path, and webUrl is the browsable link.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

assigneeId.description: User id to assign the issue to.

assigneeIds.description: User ids to assign the issue to.

epicId.description: Epic id to attach the issue to.

issues.update.title: Update Issue
issues.update.description: Update an issue by its project-scoped issueIid (not its global id). Omitted fields are left unchanged. Use stateEvent "close" or "reopen" to change state.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

issueIid.description: Project-scoped issue iid (not the global id).

assigneeIds.description: Replacement list of assignee user ids.

issues.get.title: Get Issue
issues.get.description: Fetch a single issue by its project-scoped issueIid (not its global id).

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

issueIid.description: Project-scoped issue iid (not the global id).

issues.list.title: List Issues
issues.list.description: List the issues in a project. Uses GitLab's offset pagination: pass page and perPage (max 100). The response carries no cursor in its body — the next page number comes back in the x-next-page response header and is mapped to nextPage here, empty once the last page is reached. GitLab also offers keyset pagination via a Link response header, but the declarative engine cannot parse a Link header, so this operation uses the offset form only.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

labels.description: Comma-separated label names to filter by.

perPage.description: Results per page, up to 100. Defaults to 20.

issues.comment.title: Comment on Issue
issues.comment.description: Add a comment (note) to an issue, addressed by its project-scoped issueIid. body is limited to 1,000,000 characters. The response note carries no web_url field — a link anchor of the form "<issue web_url>#note_<id>" is a UI convention, not a documented API guarantee, so it is not fabricated here.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

issueIid.description: Project-scoped issue iid (not the global id).

internal.description: Mark the note internal (visible only to members).

mergeRequests.create.title: Create Merge Request
mergeRequests.create.description: Open a merge request from sourceBranch into targetBranch. The response's id is the instance-global identifier; iid is the project-scoped number every other merge request endpoint takes in its path, and webUrl is the browsable link.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

assigneeId.description: User id to assign the merge request to.

reviewerIds.description: User ids to request review from.

removeSourceBranch.description: Delete the source branch once merged.

mergeRequests.update.title: Update Merge Request
mergeRequests.update.description: Update a merge request by its project-scoped mergeRequestIid (not its global id). Omitted fields are left unchanged. Use stateEvent "close" or "reopen" to change state.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

mergeRequestIid.description: Project-scoped merge request iid (not the global id).

stateEvent.description: Close or reopen the merge request.

assigneeIds.description: Replacement list of assignee user ids.

reviewerIds.description: Replacement list of reviewer user ids.

removeSourceBranch.description: Delete the source branch once merged.

mergeRequests.get.title: Get Merge Request
mergeRequests.get.description: Fetch a single merge request by its project-scoped mergeRequestIid (not its global id).

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

mergeRequestIid.description: Project-scoped merge request iid (not the global id).

mergeRequests.list.title: List Merge Requests
mergeRequests.list.description: List the merge requests in a project. Uses GitLab's offset pagination: pass page and perPage (max 100). The response carries no cursor in its body — the next page number comes back in the x-next-page response header and is mapped to nextPage here, empty once the last page is reached. GitLab also offers keyset pagination via a Link response header, but the declarative engine cannot parse a Link header, so this operation uses the offset form only.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

labels.description: Comma-separated label names to filter by.

perPage.description: Results per page, up to 100. Defaults to 20.

mergeRequests.merge.title: Merge Merge Request
mergeRequests.merge.description: Accept and merge a merge request by its project-scoped mergeRequestIid. sha, when supplied, must match the current HEAD of the source branch and is required if the group/instance requires a commit SHA on this API. auto_merge (not the deprecated merge_when_pipeline_succeeds) merges once checks pass. GitLab documents five failure codes, all surfaced as CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR with GitLab's own message: 400 ("SHA must be provided when merging"), 401 (no permission), 405 (the merge request cannot merge), 409 ("SHA does not match HEAD of source branch" — the supplied sha is stale), and 422 ("Branch cannot be merged").

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

mergeRequestIid.description: Project-scoped merge request iid (not the global id).

sha.description: Commit SHA that must match the current HEAD of the source branch.

autoMerge.description: Merge automatically once all checks pass.

shouldRemoveSourceBranch.description: Delete the source branch once merged.

pipelines.create.title: Create Pipeline
pipelines.create.description: Trigger a new pipeline for a branch or tag ref. Note this endpoint is singular "pipeline", unlike the plural "pipelines" used to list and get.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

ref.description: Branch or tag to run the pipeline for.

inputs.description: Pipeline inputs as a key/value object.

pipelines.get.title: Get Pipeline
pipelines.get.description: Fetch a single pipeline by its id. Note this endpoint is plural "pipelines", unlike the singular "pipeline" used to create.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

pipelines.list.title: List Pipelines
pipelines.list.description: List the pipelines for a project. Note this endpoint is plural "pipelines", unlike the singular "pipeline" used to create. Uses GitLab's offset pagination: pass page and perPage (max 100). The response carries no cursor in its body — the next page number comes back in the x-next-page response header and is mapped to nextPage here, empty once the last page is reached. GitLab also offers keyset pagination via a Link response header, but the declarative engine cannot parse a Link header, so this operation uses the offset form only.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

ref.description: Filter by branch or tag ref.

perPage.description: Results per page, up to 100. Defaults to 20.

projects.list.title: List Projects
projects.list.description: List projects visible to the caller. Pass membership=true and simple=true for the "which projects can I act on" call an agent typically needs. Uses GitLab's offset pagination: pass page and perPage (max 100). The response carries no cursor in its body — the next page number comes back in the x-next-page response header and is mapped to nextPage here, empty once the last page is reached. GitLab also offers keyset pagination via a Link response header, but the declarative engine cannot parse a Link header, so this operation uses the offset form only.

membership.description: Only projects the caller is a member of.

search.description: Search project path, name, or description.

simple.description: Return a limited, cheaper field set.

perPage.description: Results per page, up to 100. Defaults to 20.

projects.get.title: Get Project
projects.get.description: Fetch a single project. projectId is the numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "diaspora/diaspora") passed raw — it is percent-encoded for you automatically.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

projects.create.title: Create Project
projects.create.description: Create a GitLab project. name is required. path defaults to a slug of name when omitted. visibility is private, internal, or public. namespaceId places the project in a group; omit it to create under the authenticated user.

path.description: Project path (URL slug). Defaults to a slug of name.

namespaceId.description: Group or user namespace id to create the project in.

initializeWithReadme.description: Create a README on the default branch.

projects.update.title: Update Project
projects.update.description: Update a project. projectId is the numeric project id or the namespace/project path. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

issues.close.title: Close Issue
issues.close.description: Close an issue by its project-scoped issueIid. This is a dedicated close: it always sends state_event=close. Use issues.update to change other fields or to reopen.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

issueIid.description: Project-scoped issue iid (not the global id).

mergeRequests.notes.create.title: Comment on Merge Request
mergeRequests.notes.create.description: Add a comment (note) to a merge request, addressed by its project-scoped mergeRequestIid. body is limited to 1,000,000 characters. The response note carries no web_url field.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

mergeRequestIid.description: Project-scoped merge request iid (not the global id).

internal.description: Mark the note internal (visible only to members).

jobs.list.title: List Pipeline Jobs
jobs.list.description: List the jobs in a pipeline. Uses GitLab's offset pagination: pass page and perPage (max 100). The next page number comes back in the x-next-page response header and is mapped to nextPage here.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

perPage.description: Results per page, up to 100. Defaults to 20.

jobs.get.title: Get Job
jobs.get.description: Fetch a single job by its id.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

repository.files.get.title: Get Repository File
repository.files.get.description: Fetch a single file from a repository. filePath is the path within the repo (e.g. "docs/README.md") passed raw — slashes are percent-encoded for you. ref is required (branch, tag, or commit SHA). GitLab returns the file content as base64 in content.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

filePath.description: Path of the file in the repository (e.g. "src/main.rs"). Pass it raw; slashes are encoded for you.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA to read from.

groups.list.title: List Groups
groups.list.description: List groups visible to the caller. Uses GitLab's offset pagination: pass page and perPage (max 100). The next page number comes back in the x-next-page response header and is mapped to nextPage here.

minAccessLevel.description: Minimum access level the caller must have.

perPage.description: Results per page, up to 100. Defaults to 20.

groups.get.title: Get Group
groups.get.description: Fetch a single group. groupId is the numeric group id, or the full group path (e.g. "foo-bar/nested") passed raw — it is percent-encoded for you automatically.

groupId.description: Numeric group id, or the full group path (e.g. "mygroup/subgroup") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

branches.list.title: List Branches
branches.list.description: List repository branches for a project. Uses GitLab's offset pagination: pass page and perPage (max 100). The next page number comes back in the x-next-page response header and is mapped to nextPage here.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

regex.description: Filter branch names by a regular expression.

perPage.description: Results per page, up to 100. Defaults to 20.

repository.commits.list.title: List Commits
repository.commits.list.description: List repository commits for a project. refName selects a branch, tag, or SHA. Uses GitLab's offset pagination: pass page and perPage (max 100). The next page number comes back in the x-next-page response header and is mapped to nextPage here.

projectId.description: Numeric project id, or the namespace/project path (e.g. "mygroup/myproject") — pass it raw; it is encoded for you.

refName.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA to list commits from.

since.description: Only commits after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

until.description: Only commits before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

path.description: Only commits that touch this file path.

perPage.description: Results per page, up to 100. Defaults to 20.
